full_text: Intro BullseyeEZ: Mortgage Business Intelligence Platform Reports alone are insufficient in today’s changing market; you require a business intelligence solution that empowers action. What else you need is unrestricted access to data from all your software applications. Actionable insights should be effortlessly generated, understood, and communicated as necessary. BullseyeEZ is an all rounder business intelligence platform designed exclusively for lenders, supported by mortgage-experienced implementers/consultants, eliminating the need for business training. BI Tool for Finance: Designed for All Mortgage Lenders Raw data is rarely useful until it’s turned into action. As one of the best financial business intelligence tools in the market, BullseyeEZ collects data from multiple sources empowering mortgage lenders to turn data into dollars. Leverage our BI software to unveil the hidden opportunities, predict the trends of future markets, allocate resources wisely and lead your way to growth. Financial Business Intelligence Tool For Mortgage Lenders, Banks, Credit Unions & Depositories Improves Efficiency Our mortgage business intelligence platform uses understandable visualizations to help lenders work in a better way. By automating tasks and reducing unnecessary steps in the workflow, our BI tools make your mortgage processes smoother. Manage Liquidity & Market Volatility Our mortgage business intelligence solution helps identify potential liquidity risks and opportunities. By analyzing market trends, you can hedge your positions against interest rate fluctuations and economic uncertainties. Smart Planning Our financial business intelligence tool makes planning easier by showing data in easy-to-understand dashboards. Mortgage lenders can spot opportunities for growth and plan their business moves accordingly. Understanding Customers The key to running a profitable mortgage business is understanding your customers. With a business intelligence platform at your disposal determine the financial services and products that will best suit your customers. Minimize Risks In order to avoid financial risks, lenders can study customer behavior, demographics, and payment history to help understand who might struggle with payments. Instead of guessing, lenders can use real data to create payment plans, making sure people can pay back their loans on time. Compare Peer Performance To uncover the areas for improvements it’s important to benchmark your mortgage business against industry peers. With our BI platform, you can compare the essential KPIs like loan origination volume, average loan size, and default rates, against the standards set by the lending industry. Executive Dashboard Helps business leaders see the broad view of company performance helping them make necessary decisions to promote growth. See how much you spent on travel, commission, or meetings. Servicing With our analytics tool, you can easily create custom reports on your servicing portfolio to learn how your loans are performing. sections.title: Executive Dashboard
sections.content: Helps business leaders see the broad view of company performance helping them make necessary decisions to promote growth.

sections.title: Underwriter Dashboard
sections.content: Assists underwriters in making smarter decisions by providing information about loan risks.

sections.title: Processor Dashboard
sections.content: Make loan processing smoother with to-the-point performance tracking and accountability.

sections.title: Sales Dashboard
sections.content: Equip sales teams with tools based on data to improve sales and efficiency.

sections.title: Production
sections.content: Easily monitor sales and pipeline performance. Our tool cleans and optimizes the data, saving you time and effort. Connect it to your LOS and create consolidated reports so all the relevant departments can access and analyze the same info. Our mortgage banking BI tool is mobile-optimized, so you can see how your company is doing even on the go.

sections.title: Operations
sections.content: Being one of the best mortgage business intelligence platforms, BullseyeEZ helps speed up your loan origination process and minimize the expenditures. You can analyze loan data to identify recurring issues and create solutions. Set targets for your team members and provide them with regular feedback on their work.

sections.title: Finance
sections.content: Connect BullseyeEZ to General Ledger accounting, invoicing, and sales software to create detailed financial reports that break down spending. See how much you spent on travel, commission, or meetings.

sections.title: Servicing
sections.content: With our analytics tool, you can easily create custom reports on your servicing portfolio to learn how your loans are performing. We can even include data from your mortgage loan subservicer to make things easier.

sections.title: Sold Loan Reporting
sections.content: Investor Performance Rankings, Investor Pricing Trends, Loan Product Sales, Investor Pricing Comparisons, Investor Sales Volume, Loan Changes After Sale, Investor Processing Speed

sections.title: Locked Loan Reporting
sections.content: Average Loan Lock Period, Total Locked Loans, Daily Loan Lock Count, Loan Officer Performance, Property Type, Industry Average Interest Rates, Top Performing Loans

sections.title: Capital Markets Reporting
sections.content: Interest Rate Adjustment Modeling, Pricing Spread Optimization, Best Execution Analysis (Agency vs. Aggregator)

sections.title: Ad-Hoc Reporting
sections.content: Gain real-time insights and easy data exploration, and export to Excel for further analytics.

sections.title: Customizable Dashboards
sections.content: Customize your dashboard using flexible XML, ensuring it aligns with your unique needs.

sections.title: Report Scheduler
sections.content: Schedule reports and dashboards to be sent directly to your email, ensuring you never miss essential updates.

sections.title: Expertise Intact
sections.content: Designed for mortgage lenders by a team with deep industry knowledge.

sections.title: Drive Actionable Insights
sections.content: Create dashboards to solve business challenges.

sections.title: Track Progress Effectively
sections.content: Set clear goals and monitor performance over time.

sections.title: Customized Information
sections.content: Provide relevant reports for all levels. Ensure private data is protected.

sections.title: In-Depth Insights
sections.content: Combine data from various sources to identify trends and patterns.

sections.title: Visualize KPIs
sections.content: Develop custom applications for engaging performance overviews.

sections.title: Automate Reporting
sections.content: Distribute reports on a set schedule or based on specific triggers.

sections.title: Quick Implementation
sections.content: Benefit from pre-built reports and flexible customization options.

sections.title: Scalable Solution
sections.content: Cater to mortgage lending businesses of all sizes.
